name: How long does a typical bathroom lighting upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom lighting upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom lighting upgrade depends on its complexity. A straightforward replacement of existing fixtures can often be completed in a single day. Projects involving new wiring, adding recessed lights, or relocating switches might take 2-3 days, including prep work and final installation. Larger projects, especially those integrated into a full bathroom renovation, will have longer timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple fixture replacements take one day; projects with new wiring or recessed lights can take 2-3 days. Full renovations extend timelines.
